messages:
Evan: quick ask — onboarding cedar-6b (fp16, default kv-cache). Need a lightweight smoke + perf pass: steady-state throughput, p50/p95 tail, and a quick memory profile. Can someone pick this up today?

Priya: I can take it. plan: 1) smoke (seq 64/256), 2) throughput sweep (batch 1..8), 3) tail latency sweep (parallelism 1/4). will post commands + raw logs.

Evan: awesome — also add a quick canary against prod model routing (same prompts) to check quality parity. no full eval, just a handful of prompts.

Priya: noted. running now. command I use for throughput:
```bash
./run_bench --model cedar-6b --dtype fp16 --seq 256 --batch 1 --mode throughput --iters 500 --out /tmp/cedar_throughput.json
```
will run seq64/256 and batch 1/2/4/8.

Mateo: FYI I pushed a small runtime flag that affects chunking (PR #4321). if you see weird perf jumps, ping me.

Priya: seeing initial warmup behaviour — first ~50 iters higher latency. steady state after ~120 iters. posting p95 samples in a sec.

perf-bot: cedar-6b throughput job finished: throughput=230 tokens/sec (batch=1, seq=256), mem_peak=9.1GB, p50=12ms, p95=58ms. raw: /artifacts/2076123456/throughput.json

Priya: results (quick summary):
- seq 64, batch 1: 520 tok/s, p95 22ms, mem 7.3GB
- seq 256, batch 1: 230 tok/s, p95 58ms, mem 9.1GB
- seq 256, batch 4: 780 tok/s, p95 210ms, mem 10.8GB

Li: those p95 numbers for batch4 look high — likely due to tail-blocking from kv-cache growth. can you paste a flame/profile?

Priya: attaching quick perf flame (trimmed):
```text
CPU: scheduling spikes at token-gen step
GPU: kernel 0x3a slow on seq>128, ~30% longer
KV cache: steady growth until full, then GC spike at iteration ~180
```
/artifacts/2076123456/flame.svg

Jordan: quick code-review ping on the bench harness change — left a comment on the new batching knob. PR link: https://git.redwood/infra/bench/pull/98

Mateo: I think my chunking flag could be interacting — I'll run the same throughput with flag off and compare.

perf-bot: cedar-6b tail-latency sweep finished: p50=11ms, p95=62ms, p99=140ms (seq256, batch1). detailed logs: /artifacts/2076123456/latency.json

Priya: canary prompt set (5 prompts) ran against prod route and cedar-6b. qualitative: matches baseline for 4/5 prompts, one prompt had truncated output (likely kv-cache or tokenization edge). diffs: /artifacts/2076123456/canary-diffs.txt

Evan: thanks. action items:
- Mateo: run with chunking flag off and post comparative numbers (assigned).
- Priya: follow up on the GC spike & small flame detail, try seq-512 smoke and report mem behavior.
- Jordan: merge bench harness PR after addressing comment, coordinate with Mateo for a quick rollback plan if perf reg appears.

Mateo: starting run now (flag off). ETA ~20m.

Priya: starting seq-512 smoke to check mem: `./run_bench --model cedar-6b --seq 512 --batch 1 --iters 200`

perf-bot: cedar-6b seq-512 smoke: mem_peak=12.6GB, OOMs=0, p95=120ms. logs: /artifacts/2076123456/seq512.json

Li: 12.6GB is expected territory. if customers need seq512 with batch>1 we'll need a quant profile.

Mateo: comparison (chunk flag off): seq256 batch1 throughput=245 tok/s (+6.5%), p95=54ms (-7%). no obvious GC spikes in this run. attaching logs: /artifacts/2076123456/mateo-compare.json

Priya: bingo — that aligns. GC spike probably interacts with chunking flag. I'll re-run with a short interval to exercise GC paths and capture detailed heap.

Evan: great troubleshooting. for release notes we should include: steady-state perf numbers, memory envelope for seq512, and the chunking-flag note with mitigations. also call out the single canary diff.

Jordan: will hold PR merge until bench harness change has the extra test + Mateo sign-off.

Priya: final note — minor follow-up: recommend adding an automated small-canary test to CI that runs 5 prompts against prod vs new model routing to catch those truncation diffs early. :+1:

Evan: agreed. thanks all.
